decision: **A brief merges itself on green CI.** The writer of a brief, after pushing `brief/J<n>`, runs `python3 tools/pr_policy.py --branch brief/J<n> --base origin/main` (must say ok), opens the pull request and runs `gh pr merge brief/J<n> --auto --squash`: GitHub merges only when every required check passes, and the `policy` check limits the branch to `jobs/J<n>/brief.md` and row J<n> (`queued` with its brief). No agent waits or polls. Replaces "`brief/` branches still wait for Liam" in D32; `plan/` and `meta/` still wait for Liam. Liam can still edit or close the pull request before CI finishes.
